turns.question: On average, how many days did it take to hire a candidate, over everyone hired in October 2026?
turns.answer: It took an average of 6.1 days (6.0833 days) from applying to being hired, over the candidates hired from 1 to 31 October 2026. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
